resolved_integration_note: The retained final-tests E0063 was an omitted bandwidth_profile value in one existing config test Plan literal. The author supplied Default::default(); this final source was inspected. Successful root rerun remains a separate execution gate.
reviewed_properties: Only Standard and Experimental64MiB are representable; serde and CLI spell them standard and experimental64. Missing legacy JSON/CLI input selects Standard; unknown strings fail.
Standard selects 4194304 bytes/s; Experimental64MiB selects 67108864 bytes/s. Both retain the existing 8388608-byte token burst, 128-stream ceiling, idle timeout and bounded backpressure.
The mailbox handler owns an independent budget. Existing shared egress/broker budgets and trusted-builder behavior are unchanged; profile selection does not affect display, GPU or other ports.

The profile is explicit host authority, threaded through Plan to worker argv, HostChannels, RunInputs, VirtioVsock and mailbox EgressBudget. Guest bootstrap values cannot widen the already-installed host policy.

The profile-aware setter checks live bridge connections, remembered headers and pending outbound bytes before replacing the budget or endpoint, so active reservations cannot be stranded by that setter.

Host-channel rebinding first stops I/O and clears handlers; fresh handlers use Standard. Existing handoff masks do not inherit a mailbox route/profile, and production hostd still leaves mailbox_socket absent.

Worker and session receipts include selected profile and effective rate/burst; the comparison must pair arms under the same profile. A changed rate cap is a transport configuration change, not an encoder speedup.
The zero-copy repeat identity work, cryptographic authorization, frame/queue limits, single-call window and durable publication logic are outside this profile delta and are not bypassed.

evidence.controlled_clock_budget_test: Written and source-reviewed; its direct upstream workspace build was interrupted before test execution. bandwidth-budget-interruption.json explicitly marks this NOT_A_RED_RESULT. No passing runtime result is inferred.
